name: qkh_head_tstage
why_floorplan: Pin-density-sized die relay leaf (1,575 b: head t word 1,559 + e 16), one flop a bit, straight-through. hs1 (21.6 x 166.32, PPL 32-bit groups) EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION: GRT-0116 vertical overflow M3 2,341 / M5 1,204 in y 67-99 um; nets ti_a[179]/[1041]/[1297] share one gcell = the W and E groups were placed independently in different orders, so bits crossed vertically in a 17-um-wide core (840 vertical tracks per cut); pin slots 2 x 1,575 = 3,150 of 3,465 M4 face tracks (0.91). hs2: height from pin density = 2-track slots <= 0.60 of M4 face tracks -> 259.2 um (5,310 usable tracks, occupancy 0.593, 0.297 bits/track, both faces), exact io_tcl pins: bit k on the SAME M4 track W (in) and E (out), index order, >= 3-track pitch, so every bit is one horizontal route and vertical demand is only the clock. Fits the 43.2-um head-column gaps (head slot 492.48 tall).
structural_change: NEW (v1.4 queue rank 1, kvsys lead r7 07:02): ECTL -> head per-head registered copy, N = 2 stages uniform (two instances a head; stage 1 at the ECTL C face removes the 1-flop -> 8 front-leaf fan-out over ~1 mm, -1388 ps), +2 cycles on every ECTL->head issue, compiler-scheduled; no valid/ready/credit. hs2: outline 21.6 x 166.32 -> 21.6 x 259.2 (+56 % leaf area, +194 um2 per instance, 2 a head) sized from face pin density, and exact straight-through pin order replacing per-face PPL groups; RTL, cycles and benches unchanged.
